title.narrative: SUPPORT FOR INHANCING LOCAL CAPACITIES & PRACTICES

description.narrative: The Enhancing Local Capacities and Practices for Social Cohesion and Harmony project is implemented by Association of Pastoralist Community for Change (APCfC). The project seeks to enhance community structures and leadership to support social cohesion. Improved social cohesion will, in turn, build inter-community collaboration and improve the use of shared resources. The project will also work to enhance the participation and decision-making role of women and youth in community affairs. The overarching objective is to promote social cohesion and a culture of peaceful coexistence among the Borena, Garba, and Geri communities in the borderlands of Moyale Districts.
